protein_interactions.summary: BioGRID returned 196 high-confidence physical interactions for TOP2B, including key DNA damage response proteins, chromatin remodelers, transcription factors, and importantly TOP2A itself

key_interaction_partners.significance: CRITICAL - Both TOP2A and TOP2B form physical complexes, suggesting coordinated regulation. Differential inhibition may be challenging but pathway-level regulation possible
DNA damage checkpoint - TP53 activation by TOP2B-DNA complexes may contribute to cardiotoxicity apoptosis
Chromatin remodeling - HDAC inhibitors shown to modulate TOP2 activity and doxorubicin sensitivity
Chromatin remodeling partner with HDAC1
MAJOR - DNA damage response enzyme. PARP inhibitors synergize with doxorubicin in tumor cells but may increase cardiotoxicity. Key hub protein
DNA repair - BRCA1 loss sensitizes to TOP2 poisons. Cardioprotective role via DNA repair maintenance
Master DNA damage kinase - ATM activation by TOP2B-mediated DSBs triggers apoptosis in cardiomyocytes
Mismatch repair - may influence response to TOP2-induced DNA damage
Ku70 - NHEJ pathway for DSB repair. Critical for survival following TOP2B-mediated breaks
Fanconi anemia pathway - crosslink repair and genomic stability
DNA damage tolerance - translesion synthesis pathway
CSB protein - nucleotide excision repair and transcription-coupled repair
BRM - SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex ATPase subunit
BRG1 - SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex ATPase subunit, regulates accessibility
BAF47/INI1 - core SWI/SNF subunit
BAF155 - SWI/SNF subunit
BAF170 - SWI/SNF subunit
BAF57 - SWI/SNF subunit
Mi-2α - NuRD complex chromatin remodeler
Mi-2β - NuRD complex chromatin remodeler
CTCF - master chromatin organizer, regulates 3D genome architecture and TOP2 recruitment
Estrogen receptor α - hormone signaling may influence TOP2B expression and cardiotoxicity (sex differences)
MYC oncogene - drives TOP2A expression in tumors. Differential MYC activity between tumor/heart may enable selective targeting
BET bromodomain protein - regulates transcription. BET inhibitors alter TOP2 expression
Polycomb repressive complex 2 - histone methyltransferase, epigenetic regulator
p300 - histone acetyltransferase, transcriptional coactivator
SUMOylation regulates TOP2B localization and activity
SUMOylation pathway
UBC9 - SUMO E2 conjugating enzyme, critical for TOP2B SUMOylation
SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligase - regulates TOP2B degradation after DNA damage
SUMO E3 ligase - regulates TOP2B SUMOylation and activity
F-box E3 ubiquitin ligase - degrades oncoproteins including MYC
β-TrCP - SCF E3 ubiquitin ligase component, regulates TOP2B stability
Cohesin complex - sister chromatid cohesion, works with TOP2
Topoisomerase I - alternative topoisomerase, compensatory upregulation possible

functional_clusters.relevance: Proteins mediating cell death response to TOP2B-DNA damage. ATM/TP53 axis drives cardiotoxicity apoptosis
Regulate chromatin accessibility and TOP2 recruitment. HDAC/BET inhibitors modulate doxorubicin sensitivity
Post-translational control of TOP2B stability, localization, and activity. Potential therapeutic targets
Control TOP2A/TOP2B expression levels. MYC drives TOP2A in tumors, tissue-specific regulators may enable selective modulation

pathways.summary: WikiPathways identified 7 oxidative stress/antioxidant pathways for SOD2, 13 RAS/MAPK/cancer pathways for NF1, and 4 cancer-related pathways for TOP2A

SOD2.title: Selenium micronutrient network
SOD2.relevance: SOD2 protective network - selenium-dependent antioxidant system. GPX1 (glutathione peroxidase) also in this pathway

SOD2.title: Oxidative stress response
SOD2.relevance: CRITICAL - Core oxidative stress response pathway. Contains SOD2, CAT, GPX1, GST enzymes. Central to cardioprotection

SOD2.title: Molecular pathway for oxidative stress
SOD2.relevance: CRITICAL - Detailed ROS handling pathway. Likely contains antioxidant enzyme cascade: SOD2→CAT/GPX1

SOD2.title: Folate metabolism
SOD2.relevance: One-carbon metabolism linked to oxidative stress via NADPH production for glutathione recycling

SOD2.title: Vitamin B12 metabolism
SOD2.relevance: Nutritional cofactor for methionine synthase, links to folate cycle

SOD2.title: VEGFA-VEGFR2 signaling
SOD2.relevance: Angiogenesis and endothelial function - ROS regulation in vasculature

SOD2.title: Female steroid hormones in cardiomyocyte energy metabolism
SOD2.relevance: Sex-specific cardioprotection - estrogen upregulates antioxidant enzymes including SOD2. May explain female protection from doxorubicin cardiotoxicity

NF1.title: MAPK signaling
NF1.relevance: CRITICAL - NF1 loss causes hyperactive MAPK signaling. MAPK pathway influences both tumor drug sensitivity and cardiac stress responses

NF1.title: Ras signaling
NF1.relevance: CRITICAL - NF1 is RAS-GAP. Hyperactive RAS may affect: (1) tumor anthracycline sensitivity, (2) cardiac mitochondrial function

NF1.title: NF1 copy number variation syndrome
NF1.relevance: CRITICAL - NF1-specific pathway covering genomic deletions and duplications at chr17:29.1-30.28Mb affecting up to 14 genes

NF1.title: Pilocytic astrocytoma
NF1.relevance: NF1-associated tumor - BRAF/MAPK activation. Illustrates tissue-specific oncogenic mechanisms

NF1.title: Glioblastoma signaling
NF1.relevance: NF1 among frequently altered genes in glioblastoma

NF1.title: EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance
NF1.relevance: NF1 loss causes TKI resistance via RAS bypass signaling

NF1.title: Melanoma
NF1.relevance: NF1 mutations in melanoma - MAPK activation and drug resistance

NF1.title: Integrated breast cancer pathway
NF1.relevance: Breast cancer context where NF1 patients may receive doxorubicin

NF1.title: Fragile X syndrome
NF1.relevance: mTOR/TSC pathway regulation - potential crosstalk with NF1/RAS signaling

NF1.title: Synaptic signaling associated with autism spectrum disorder
NF1.relevance: mTOR activation - NF1 patients have neurological symptoms, mTOR is downstream of RAS

NF1.title: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor response to main mediators PAH and TCDD
NF1.relevance: Xenobiotic metabolism and detoxification - may influence anthracycline metabolism

NF1.title: Transcription co-factors SKI and SKIL protein partners

TOP2A.title: Gastric cancer network 1
TOP2A.relevance: Oncogene network - TOP2A as proliferation marker in cancer

TOP2A.title: Retinoblastoma gene in cancer
TOP2A.relevance: RB pathway - cell cycle regulation. TOP2A is E2F target gene, expressed in S/G2 phases

TOP2A.title: Circadian rhythm genes
TOP2A.relevance: Circadian regulation - TOP2A expression may be time-dependent. Chronotherapy implications for doxorubicin administration

oxidative_stress_DNA_damage_axis.description: SOD2/CAT/GPX1 antioxidant pathway (WP:WP408, WP:WP5477) protects against doxorubicin-induced ROS. ROS damages DNA triggering TOP2B-DNA damage response (PARP1, ATM, TP53). Antioxidant upregulation reduces DNA damage burden
oxidative_stress_DNA_damage_axis.therapeutic_opportunity: Enhance antioxidant pathway in cardiomyocytes via NRF2 activation or direct enzyme supplementation
oxidative_stress_DNA_damage_axis.evidence: SOD2 overexpression cardioprotective in preclinical models

glutathione_detoxification_network.description: GSTM1/GSTP1 conjugate glutathione to doxorubicin metabolites and ROS-damaged lipids. Linked to oxidative stress pathway via glutathione recycling (folate/B12 pathways WP:WP176, WP:WP1533 provide NADPH)
glutathione_detoxification_network.therapeutic_opportunity: Boost glutathione synthesis (NAC supplementation) or GST enzyme activity
glutathione_detoxification_network.evidence: GSTM1-null genotype associated with increased cardiotoxicity in clinical studies

RAS_MAPK_tumor_specificity.description: NF1 loss causes hyperactive RAS/MAPK (WP:WP382, WP:WP4223). MAPK activity regulates: (1) TOP2A expression via MYC/E2F in tumors, (2) oxidative stress responses, (3) mitochondrial function. Differential pathway activity tumor vs. heart
RAS_MAPK_tumor_specificity.therapeutic_opportunity: MEK inhibitors may reduce tumor TOP2A expression while preserving cardiac function. Combined MEK inhibitor + doxorubicin may improve therapeutic index
RAS_MAPK_tumor_specificity.evidence: RAS-driven cancers often have high TOP2A expression and anthracycline sensitivity

chromatin_remodeling_accessibility.description: SWI/SNF complex (SMARCA2/4, SMARCB1, SMARCC1/2, SMARCE1) and HDAC1/2 regulate chromatin accessibility at TOP2 binding sites. Chromatin state differs between cardiomyocytes (post-mitotic, condensed) and tumor cells (proliferating, open)
chromatin_remodeling_accessibility.therapeutic_opportunity: HDAC inhibitors or BET inhibitors (BRD4) could modulate TOP2A/TOP2B expression tissue-specifically. May reduce TOP2B in heart while maintaining TOP2A in tumor
chromatin_remodeling_accessibility.evidence: BioGRID shows TOP2B interacts with HDAC1/2/3, SMARCA2/4, CHD3/4, BRD4. Epigenetic drugs in clinical trials for cancer

sumoylation_degradation_control.description: TOP2B is regulated by SUMOylation (SUMO1/2, UBE2I, PIAS4) and ubiquitin-mediated degradation (RNF4, BTRC). SUMO-ubiquitin crosstalk controls TOP2B protein levels post-DNA damage
sumoylation_degradation_control.therapeutic_opportunity: Small molecules targeting SUMO or ubiquitin pathways could accelerate TOP2B degradation in cardiomyocytes after doxorubicin exposure, reducing sustained DNA damage
sumoylation_degradation_control.evidence: RNF4 is SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligase - degrades SUMOylated TOP2B. Upregulation could be cardioprotective

estrogen_sex_difference.description: Estrogen receptor ESR1 interacts with TOP2B. Female steroid hormones regulate cardiomyocyte energy metabolism and antioxidant enzymes (WP:WP5318). Estrogen upregulates SOD2 expression
estrogen_sex_difference.therapeutic_opportunity: Estrogen or selective ER modulators may provide cardioprotection in postmenopausal women receiving doxorubicin. Sex-stratified clinical trials needed
estrogen_sex_difference.evidence: Premenopausal women have lower cardiotoxicity rates than men or postmenopausal women

candidate_targets.description: Genes/proteins identified as high-priority therapeutic targets for selective cardioprotection while preserving anti-tumor efficacy
selection_criteria: Differential expression or activity between cardiomyocytes and tumor cells
Preclinical or clinical evidence of cardioprotection

targets.rationale: Primary cardiotoxicity mediator. Direct TOP2B-selective inhibitors (dexrazoxane metabolites target both TOP2A/B but may have isoform selectivity) or TOP2B expression suppressors
targets.druggability: HIGH - existing topoisomerase inhibitors, developing isoform-selective compounds
targets.approach: Isoform-selective inhibition or cardiac-specific TOP2B suppression
targets.risk: Must preserve TOP2A for anti-tumor efficacy

targets.rationale: Converts doxorubicin to cardiotoxic doxorubicinol. CBR1 inhibition reduces cardiotoxicity without affecting tumor TOP2 poisoning
targets.druggability: MODERATE - small molecule enzyme inhibitors in development
targets.approach: CBR1 selective inhibitors co-administered with doxorubicin
targets.risk: Low - CBR1 not required for anti-tumor effect

targets.rationale: DNA damage response hub (5 experimental systems). PARP inhibitors synergize with doxorubicin in tumors but may increase cardiotoxicity. Tissue-specific PARP modulation challenging but high impact
targets.druggability: VERY HIGH - multiple FDA-approved PARP inhibitors (olaparib, rucaparib, niraparib, talazoparib)
targets.approach: Careful dosing/scheduling of PARP inhibitors + doxorubicin, or cardiac-protective PARP activation
targets.risk: Biphasic - PARP inhibition potentiates tumor kill but may worsen cardiotoxicity

targets.rationale: Master DNA damage kinase driving apoptosis. ATM inhibitors prevent TOP2B-mediated cardiotoxicity but may reduce tumor cell killing
targets.druggability: HIGH - ATM inhibitors in clinical trials (AZD0156, AZD1390)
targets.approach: Transient ATM inhibition during doxorubicin peak cardiac exposure
targets.risk: May reduce tumor response if not carefully timed

targets.rationale: Apoptosis hub downstream of TOP2B-DNA damage. TP53 inhibition cardioprotective but tumor cells often have mutant TP53 (enabling selective protection of TP53-WT heart)
targets.druggability: MODERATE - p53 modulators exist but challenging
targets.approach: Transient p53 inhibition in WT cardiomyocytes; tumors with p53 mutations unaffected
targets.risk: Timing critical to avoid protecting p53-WT tumor cells

targets.rationale: Master regulator of antioxidant response including SOD2, CAT, GPX1, GSTM1, GSTP1. NRF2 activators upregulate entire protective network
targets.druggability: MODERATE - NRF2 activators include bardoxolone, sulforaphane, dimethyl fumarate
targets.approach: NRF2 activation before/during doxorubicin to boost antioxidant capacity
targets.risk: May protect tumors if they retain NRF2 function
targets.provenance: WikiPathways WP:WP408, WP:WP5477 + Phase 2 gene enrichment

targets.rationale: Mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme. SOD2 mimetics or gene therapy upregulation directly scavenges doxorubicin-induced superoxide
targets.druggability: MODERATE - SOD mimetics (MnTBAP, GC4419) in development
targets.approach: SOD mimetic co-administration or cardiac-targeted SOD2 gene therapy
targets.risk: Low - antioxidants generally cardioprotective without reducing tumor response

targets.rationale: Chromatin remodelers physically interacting with TOP2B. HDAC inhibitors modulate TOP2 activity and expression. May enable tissue-specific TOP2B suppression
targets.druggability: VERY HIGH - multiple FDA-approved HDAC inhibitors (vorinostat, romidepsin, belinostat, panobinostat)
targets.approach: HDAC inhibitors to suppress cardiac TOP2B expression or modify chromatin accessibility
targets.risk: HDAC inhibitors have broad effects; isoform-selective HDACs preferred

targets.rationale: BET bromodomain protein regulating transcription including TOP2A/B. BET inhibitors alter TOP2 expression
targets.druggability: HIGH - BET inhibitors in clinical trials (JQ1, OTX015, BMS-986158)
targets.approach: BET inhibition to suppress cardiac TOP2B while preserving tumor TOP2A
targets.risk: BET inhibitors have anti-tumor effects themselves; complex interaction with doxorubicin

targets.rationale: Drives TOP2A expression in tumors. MYC is hyperactive in RAS-driven NF1-associated cancers. MYC inhibition reduces TOP2A (reducing efficacy) but may spare heart
targets.druggability: LOW-MODERATE - MYC inhibitors challenging but OMO-103, MYCi361 in development
targets.approach: Tumor-specific context - unlikely to be cardioprotective but important for efficacy side
targets.provenance: BioGRID TOP2B interactions + NF1 pathway context

targets.rationale: SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligase degrading TOP2B. RNF4 upregulation could accelerate TOP2B degradation in cardiomyocytes post-damage
targets.druggability: LOW - E3 ligase modulation challenging but emerging (PROTACs, molecular glues)
targets.approach: Enhance RNF4 activity to promote TOP2B degradation in heart
targets.risk: Timing important - need TOP2B degradation after doxorubicin clears

targets.rationale: SUMO E2 enzyme (UBC9) - critical for TOP2B SUMOylation which regulates activity. Modulation complex due to broad SUMO pathway effects
targets.approach: Research tool to understand SUMOylation contribution to cardiotoxicity

targets.rationale: MAPK pathway kinases downstream of hyperactive RAS in NF1-deficient cells. MEK inhibitors reduce proliferation and TOP2A expression in tumors
targets.druggability: VERY HIGH - FDA-approved MEK inhibitors (trametinib, cobimetinib, binimetinib, selumetinib)
targets.approach: MEK inhibitor + doxorubicin combination for NF1-associated tumors. MEK inhibition may reduce cardiac MAPK stress responses too
targets.risk: Need to validate MEK inhibition doesn't reduce doxorubicin efficacy (may actually synergize in RAS-driven tumors)
targets.provenance: WikiPathways WP:WP382, WP:WP4223 + Phase 2 NF1 enrichment

targets.rationale: Estrogen receptor regulates SOD2 and cardiac energy metabolism. Estrogen cardioprotective. Relevant for female NF1 patients
targets.druggability: VERY HIGH - selective estrogen receptor modulators (SERMs) FDA-approved
targets.approach: SERM co-administration to provide cardioprotection especially in postmenopausal women
targets.risk: Estrogen effects on hormone-sensitive tumors need consideration

targets.rationale: Glutathione is substrate for GST-mediated detoxification and GPX1 antioxidant function. Boosting glutathione supports both pathways
targets.druggability: HIGH - N-acetylcysteine (NAC) is FDA-approved glutathione precursor
targets.risk: Very low - NAC well-tolerated, some evidence of cardioprotection without reducing tumor response
targets.provenance: Phase 2 enrichment (GSTM1, GSTP1, GPX1) + WikiPathways WP:WP15, WP:WP408

hub_genes.significance: Central node linking TOP2B-DNA damage to cell fate decisions. Highly druggable
CRITICAL - TOP2A and TOP2B physically interact, complicating selective inhibition strategies. Tissue-specific expression/regulation may be key
Controls chromatin accessibility at TOP2 sites. Differential SWI/SNF composition in heart vs. tumor cells enables selective targeting

hub_genes.interaction_count: UBE2I (4 systems), SUMO1, SUMO2, PIAS4, RNF4
hub_genes.significance: Regulates TOP2B stability and activity. SUMOylation-ubiquitination crosstalk controls protein degradation
Mediates cell death response to TOP2B-DNA damage. Direct target for cardioprotection

pathway_crosstalk_points.nodes: Doxorubicin redox cycling → SOD2/CAT/GPX1 overwhelmed → Mitochondrial ROS → DNA damage → TOP2B-DNA complexes → ATM → TP53 → Apoptosis
pathway_crosstalk_points.therapeutic_leverage: Block at multiple points: (1) Boost antioxidants (SOD2, NAC), (2) Inhibit TOP2B, (3) Block ATM/TP53

pathway_crosstalk_points.nodes: SWI/SNF + HDAC + BRD4 → Chromatin accessibility → TOP2B recruitment → DNA damage severity
pathway_crosstalk_points.therapeutic_leverage: Modify chromatin to reduce TOP2B recruitment in cardiomyocytes: HDAC inhibitors or BET inhibitors

pathway_crosstalk_points.nodes: MYC/E2F → TOP2A expression (tumor) vs. constitutive TOP2B (heart) → Differential damage
pathway_crosstalk_points.therapeutic_leverage: Exploit proliferation-dependent TOP2A in tumors vs. constitutive TOP2B in quiescent cardiomyocytes

pathway_crosstalk_points.nodes: NF1 loss → Hyperactive RAS → MAPK → MYC → TOP2A upregulation in tumors
pathway_crosstalk_points.therapeutic_leverage: NF1-specific: MEK inhibitor + doxorubicin may reduce tumor TOP2A while sparing cardiac TOP2B

pathway_crosstalk_points.nodes: Estrogen → ESR1 → SOD2/antioxidant gene expression → ROS scavenging
pathway_crosstalk_points.therapeutic_leverage: Sex-specific cardioprotection: SERMs for postmenopausal women receiving doxorubicin

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: Develop or repurpose TOP2B-selective inhibitors for cardiac protection while maintaining TOP2A-mediated tumor kill
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.feasibility: MODERATE - chemical selectivity challenging but dexrazoxane shows isoform effects
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: TOP2A/TOP2B have 70% sequence homology but distinct tissue expression; dexrazoxane cardioprotective

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: Use chromatin modifiers (HDAC inhibitors, BET inhibitors) to epigenetically suppress TOP2B in cardiomyocytes
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.feasibility: MODERATE-HIGH - existing drugs, need cardiac delivery optimization
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: BioGRID shows TOP2B interacts with HDAC1/2/3, BRD4, CHD3/4; these are druggable

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: Activate NRF2 (master regulator) to upregulate SOD2, CAT, GPX1, GSTs simultaneously
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.feasibility: HIGH - NRF2 activators available (bardoxolone, sulforaphane, DMF)
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: WikiPathways WP:WP408, WP:WP5477 show coordinated antioxidant response

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: Block doxorubicin → doxorubicinol conversion to prevent cardiotoxic metabolite formation
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: CBR1 polymorphisms associated with cardiotoxicity; knockout mice protected

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: Transiently inhibit ATM or p53 in cardiomyocytes during doxorubicin exposure to prevent apoptosis
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.feasibility: MODERATE - ATM inhibitors in trials; timing critical
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: ATM/p53 axis drives cardiomyocyte apoptosis; p53 often mutant in tumors (enabling selectivity)

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: For NF1-associated tumors, combine MEK inhibitor with doxorubicin to reduce hyperactive MAPK-driven TOP2A expression
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: NF1 loss → RAS/MAPK hyperactivation → TOP2A upregulation. MEK inhibition may reduce both tumor burden and cardiac stress

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: NAC supplementation to boost glutathione for GST-mediated detoxification and GPX1 antioxidant activity
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: GSTM1-null genotype increases cardiotoxicity; glutathione required for GSTP1 and GPX1 function

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: Enhance SUMO-ubiquitin pathway (RNF4 activity) to accelerate TOP2B degradation after doxorubicin exposure
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.feasibility: LOW - E3 ligase activation challenging but emerging field (molecular glues, PROTACs)
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: RNF4 degrades SUMOylated TOP2B; enhanced degradation could limit sustained DNA damage in heart

therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.description: SERM co-administration in postmenopausal women to provide estrogen-like cardioprotection (SOD2 upregulation, metabolic support)
therapeutic_opportunities_for_selective_.evidence: Premenopausal women have lower cardiotoxicity; estrogen upregulates SOD2 and antioxidant enzymes

limitations_and_notes.tool_budget_status: Used 7 of 8 allocated tool calls. Remaining 1 call reserved for error correction
limitations_and_notes.data_quality: High - BioGRID data comprehensive (196 TOP2B interactions), WikiPathways provided relevant oxidative stress and RAS/MAPK pathways
limitations_and_notes.expansion_completeness: GOOD - Achieved core objectives: (1) TOP2B interaction network mapped, (2) Key pathways identified for SOD2, NF1, TOP2A, (3) Hub proteins and crosstalk points identified, (4) Therapeutic targets prioritized
limitations_and_notes.next_phase_readiness: Data sufficient for PHASE 4 TRAVERSE - candidate targets identified with druggability assessment, mechanistic rationale, and pathway context
